basePrompt: Generate ONE isolated apparel/accessory asset for an Expo mannequin dressing app. Photorealistic premium product render, truly transparent alpha background, object has natural worn volume on a completely invisible mannequin, not a flat lay. No mannequin body, head, face, hands, skin, hanger, stand, text, logo, frame, environment, floor or ground shadow. Orthographic straight front view, centered and fully in frame, consistent soft neutral studio lighting only on the object. ONE requested item only, do not add any other garments. Clothing sleeves hang in a symmetrical narrow A pose with arms 10 degrees away from torso. Keep generous transparent padding. Clothes portrait 1024x1536; accessories/jewelry square 1024x1024.
